notes.title: Adds in two more stances and moves!
notes.content:
[h3]a big update with two more stances (Character basic moves), ten more skills and two brand new models. In addition, the OST is also released on the shelf.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/7b715fb2f3cad75b48af34827c0cf84908cb00cd.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=L4dnxDTYnrQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New STEELs are the “Metal Savior” and “STEEL Zulai”, with their new stances which is “Quantum Divine” and “Ancient Zen” inspired from the old human world or even before it. This brings the total stances in Fight of Steel to six and with countless moves, players can almost create infinity ways to customize their own fighter.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/18984953a6643e66e67c67a13021d842c9dd52e9.png[/img]
New Stances allows player to have new elements to customize their fighters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/ac55547bac0b9afb1a042a57bcd393694ea025ff.png[/img]
One of the new move-Quantum Holy Light, as the image shows it was launch from some sort of high-tech cannon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/cf6b5871e64d95af10c8c40498b3d4bbcbfa5f58.png[/img]
New super-Super Zen palm can also be added into players move set.

[h3]Fight of Steel OST is also now on steam included 12 in game songs compressed by Local Composer/Audio Designer Shang-Feng Yang.[/h3]
[previewyoutube=oZvjLUdLUFk;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/3e2bd71c7f56624eefd17758ded73d7339e5a05c.png[/img]
[h3]Fight of Steel: Infinity warrior is also bringing out deluxe bundle with discount deal if you get the game and OST together, don’t miss it! [/h3]

notes.title: [Important] Demo Extended and New Skins Added
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! Important message:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/2f9c1b60509bba8c40fba7f51cb3d3ed9a233c27.png[/img]


We decided to extend the open demo to June 30th and provide additional features listed below:
☆☆☆☆☆ Current Skins and Skills in the demo are free in the shop.
☆☆☆☆☆ Added more Skins and Fight of Animal parts in the shop.

Thank you all for playing the demo and sharing your thoughts and content about it. We saw many amazing matches, and more importantly, we saw a lot of players create Steel fighters and combos full of personality and style. And thanks to many players who are new to fighting games being willing to try the game. We hope new players feel fun in assembling their own fighters and the Story Mode.

We extend the open demo and make the Skins and Moves free for players to try, previously players need to grind a bit through a few games to earn credits to buy them. And we provided parts of Fight of Animals characters in the shop. We hope players can explore the possibility of assembling their fighters with the current content we provide in the demo. (Invite your friends to play!)

We welcome you to try Fight of Steel:
https://bit.ly/FightOfSteel

If you like the game, please add it to your Steam wishlist. This will help us a lot! Thank you.[/h3]

tags.feature: ☆☆☆☆☆ Added more Skins and Fight of Animal parts in the shop.

notes.title: It’s time to join Steam Next Fest！！（Detailed Patch Note）
notes.content:
[h3]The Steam Next Fest in June started. Fight of Steel open demo is downloadable on Steam.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/2f64387bbc5a0bbda12dcb93bffe8096dd9c4778.jpg[/img]
We previously shared trailers for playable characters ET and Oil King. In this demo, you can redeem them freely in the Shop. ET and Oil King will stream Fight of Steel sometime this week and maybe they will be playing online matches with players. If you want to join the games, please keep an eye on our page. You might want to practice a little bit before the matches, or you want to play the game by yourself. Here are some tips for playing the game for the first time:

1. We would suggest you get familiar with the system by trying Training mode or Arcade mode. And then you can play Story mode to dip your toes in the world settings of Fight of Steel. In Story mode, there will be STEELs from the three factions showing up. We recommend you try Challenge mode later than the previous modes.

2. Online matches. You can play and practice Casual Match with your friend. If you want to challenge yourself, you could find some challenging players in Ranked Matches. Be warned, players in Ranked Matches are usually fierce.


Lastly, if you have clips of you playing the game, the interesting Skins you put together, and any thoughts you would like to share on social media, you can tag them with #FightOfSteel. That way it would be easier for us to get it!.


We welcome you to try the game![/h3]

Detailed Patch Note：
[olist]
[*] Fix bug for some gamepad button malfunction in Shop or Customization pages.
[*] Increase HP recovery amout for players each round.
[*] Adjust AI judgement for defending projectile.
[*] Adjust state change between Air Recovery and on ground.
[/olist]
